Every line of Monopoly 200X's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
696.headline: What type of game it is

762.body:
"Billion" has 1,764,545 prizes of $100 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $1 million prize, with 41 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

Billion's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

Tomorrow's count on "Billion" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
762.headline: Prize table details

827.body:
On "50th Anniversary", one $15 million top prize was claimed yesterday. That leaves one of the original three. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

How far "50th Anniversary" is through its run does not decide anything by itself. It changes how closely to look at the other numbers.

Everything above about "50th Anniversary" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
827.headline: A player won a top prize

847.body:
All the top prizes on "Bingo 50X" have been claimed. That lowers the biggest prize from $500,000 to $100,000. Two of those are still out there. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Every line of Bingo 50X's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
847.headline: Big prize shown, none left

891.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Cash Explosion 25X", only a small slice are still unsold. The game is in the last part of its run, with two of ten top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Tomorrow's count on "Cash Explosion 25X" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
